description: Sidebar unread badge, unread count polling/streaming, DM sound notification, and optimistic message updates (T-403, T-404, T-405, T-410). Add a red dot badge to the DM navigation link, fetch unread count on app init, update it via streaming events, play a notification sound when receiving messages in a non-active room, and implement optimistic UI updates for sent messages.
steps: Modify app/javascript/mastodon/features/navigation_panel/index.tsx to: (a) import useAppSelector and useAppDispatch, (b) select dm.unreadCount from the Redux store, (c) replace the plain ColumnLink for '/conversations' with one that uses IconWithBadge (following the NotificationsLink pattern) showing the unread count as a badge, (d) dispatch fetchUnreadCount on mount.

Modify app/javascript/mastodon/actions/streaming_dm.ts to: (a) on 'dm_message' event, also dispatch DM_UNREAD_COUNT_INCREMENT action when the message is from another room (not the active room), (b) on 'dm_chat_room.update' event handle unread state updates.

Add DM_UNREAD_COUNT_INCREMENT action constant to app/javascript/mastodon/actions/dm.ts. Handle it in the reducer (app/javascript/mastodon/reducers/dm.ts) to increment unreadCount. Also, in the DM_CHAT_ROOM_READ case, decrement unreadCount by 1 (if it was unread).

Add sound notification: In app/javascript/mastodon/actions/streaming_dm.ts, when dispatching DM_MESSAGE_RECEIVED for a message NOT in the active room, add meta: { sound: 'boop' } to the action. This leverages the existing soundsMiddleware which plays sounds for any action with meta.sound. The middleware in store/middlewares/sounds.ts already supports this pattern.

Implement optimistic update in app/javascript/mastodon/actions/dm.ts sendMessage action: (a) Before calling the API, dispatch a DM_MESSAGE_SEND_OPTIMISTIC action with a temporary message object (tempId, content, account_id from current user, status: 'pending'), (b) On API success, dispatch DM_MESSAGE_SEND_SUCCESS to replace the temp message with the real one, (c) On API failure, dispatch DM_MESSAGE_SEND_FAIL to mark the temp message as failed.

Add DM_MESSAGE_SEND_OPTIMISTIC and DM_MESSAGE_SEND_FAIL action types and handle them in the reducer: optimistic adds a message with a 'pending' status flag and 50% opacity indicator, success replaces it by matching tempId, failure marks it with an error flag.

Add styles to app/javascript/styles/mastodon/dm.scss for: .dm-message-item--pending (opacity: 0.5), .dm-message-item--failed (with red border and retry icon area), .dm-nav-badge (badge animation using @keyframes for scale pop effect).
acceptance_criteria: The DM navigation link shows a red dot/count when unreadCount > 0
fetchUnreadCount is called on app initialization in the navigation panel
Receiving a streaming dm_message for a non-active room increments the badge count
Marking a room as read decrements the badge count
A 'boop' sound plays when receiving a DM for a non-active room
Sending a message shows it immediately at 50% opacity (optimistic), then full opacity on success
Failed messages show a red border indicator
findings: The connectStream function from mastodon/stream.js has JSDoc type annotations that TypeScript infers. The StreamEvent type has payload typed as 'object' (not 'string'), so we import type StreamEvent and handle both string and object payloads with typeof checks. The @ts-expect-error directive is no longer needed since connectStream gained proper types. Pre-commit hooks run eslint, stylelint, tsc, oxfmt, and i18n:extract. The unread count increment logic was moved from the DM_MESSAGE_RECEIVED reducer case to a separate DM_UNREAD_COUNT_INCREMENT action dispatched from the streaming handler to avoid double-counting.
